summary: The filing is an 8-K under Item 8.01 by J.P. Morgan Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. announcing a routine monthly distribution declaration for multiple classes of common stock with a record date of May 31, 2026. The gross distribution is $0.0423 per share for all classes, with a stockholder servicing fee only for Class Y. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. It is a standard current report on other events.
